title: Home page
intro: Edit, hide and reorder the home page sections, and keep the quick stats up to date.

sections.heading: Sections
sections.intro: The home page shows them in this order. A hidden or draft section doesn't appear.
sections.nowShown: {name} is now shown on the home page.
sections.nowHidden: {name} is now hidden from the home page.
sections.rowsNote: The items themselves come from their own list in Content. Here you set the heading and introduction.

fields.heading: Heading
fields.name: Name and brand
fields.title: Professional title
fields.photoHint: One photo for both languages. It's saved with each language's text.
fields.audiencesHint: Government, humanitarian, private, in this order.

letter.paragraphsHint: From 1 to {max} paragraphs, in the order they're read.
letter.full: The letter has {max} paragraphs, the most it can hold.
letter.sharedNote: The signatures and the placeholder switch are the same in both languages. They're saved with each language's text.
letter.signatureHint: Dark ink on a transparent background. PNG only.
letter.signatureDarkHint: Light ink on a transparent background. PNG only.
letter.pngOnly: The signature must be a PNG file. SVG and other types aren't accepted.
letter.placeholder: This is a placeholder letter and signature
letter.placeholderHint: While on, the home page tags the letter “Placeholder letter and signature”. Turn it off once Ahmed's own words and signature are in.

order.drag: Drag to reorder {name}. With a keyboard, use the move up and move down buttons.
order.failed: The new order couldn't be saved, so it was put back. Try again.

stats.heading: Quick stats
stats.intro: Years of experience, projects, organizations, trainees. Only published stats show on the home page.
stats.empty: No stats yet. Add the first one.

errors.visibility: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
